units.source_text: 这枝红叶的确甚美，藤壶皇后看了也很注目，但见枝上缚着一封小小的打成结的信，一如往日作风。

en.t: This branch of red leaves was indeed very beautiful, and Empress Fujitsubo noticed it closely when she saw it, but on the branch was tied a small knotted letter, just as he had always done before.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后深恐被侍女们看见，脸色骤变，想道：“他此心终是不死，实在教人烦恼。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo was deeply afraid that her ladies-in-waiting would see it, and her face changed suddenly as she thought, “His feelings still have not died away after all; it is truly distressing.

units.source_text: 所可惜者，此人虽思虑周至，却有时做出大胆妄为的事来，外人见了得不怀疑？”

en.t: What is regrettable is that, although he is usually so thoughtful and careful, he sometimes does reckless and audacious things; if outsiders saw this, how could they fail to be suspicious?”

units.source_text: 便把这枝红叶插在花瓶里，供在檐下柱旁了。

en.t: She then placed the branch of red leaves in a vase and set it beside a pillar under the eaves.
